items.summary: Shepherd is an open-source Python substrate that enables meta-agents to fork, replay, and revert any agent run, addressing issues with long runs that accumulate state not captured in transcripts. This tool aims to improve efficiency by allowing researchers to correct mistakes without losing progress or re-running extensive sequences of actions.
items.summary_detailed: Shepherd is an open-source Python substrate that enables meta-agents to fork, replay, and revert any agent run, addressing issues with long runs that accumulate state not captured in transcripts.
